Hi everyone,
I’m looking for some recommendations. In early February my husband and I went to the interview for switching from B1 visa to A5. Our lawyer also accompanied us. They had requested for a few additional documents which we already emailed them and they also replied a few times by email saying they were still checking everything but now it’s already been three months since our interview. Is it common for them to take more than three months to give an answer? I requested our lawyer email them but he said they still didn’t reply. Of course I can also email them too , which I’m planning to do next week. But maybe it’s better just to go to the Misrad Hapnim directly?
